title: Master Guide to Indian Polity & Constitution for Banking Exams

constituent_assembly.first_meeting: 9 December 1946 (Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha as Temporary President)
constituent_assembly.drafting_committee_chairman: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar (appointed 29 August 1947, 7 members)
constituent_assembly.original_constitution: 395 Articles, 22 Parts, and 8 Schedules (Calligraphed by Prem Behari Narain Raizada, decorated by Nandalal Bose)

preamble.based_on: 'Objectives Resolution' moved by Jawaharlal Nehru on 13 December 1946 (adopted 22 Jan 1947)
preamble.amendment: Amended only once by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976 (added three words: 'SOCIALIST', 'SECULAR', and 'INTEGRITY')
preamble.objectives: Justice (Social, Economic, Political), Liberty (Thought, Expression, Belief, Faith, Worship), Equality (Status and Opportunity), Fraternity (Assuring dignity of individual and unity & integrity of the Nation)

key_court_rulings.ruling: Preamble is NOT a part of the Constitution
Preamble IS an integral part of the Constitution and can be amended under Article 368 without altering Basic Structure
Reaffirmed Preamble as an integral part of the Constitution

sources_borrowed.feature: Parliamentary Government, Rule of Law, Single Citizenship, Bicameralism, Cabinet System, Prerogative Writs
Fundamental Rights, Judicial Review, Independence of Judiciary, Impeachment of President, Removal of Supreme Court & High Court Judges, Preamble
Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP), Method of Election of the President, Nomination of Members to Rajya Sabha
Fundamental Duties (Art 51A), Ideals of Justice (Social, Economic, Political) in Preamble
Concurrent List, Freedom of Trade, Commerce and Intercourse, Joint Sitting of both Houses of Parliament (Art 108)
Suspension of Fundamental Rights during National Emergency
Federation with a strong Centre, Vesting of Residual Powers in Centre, Appointment of State Governors by Centre, Advisory Jurisdiction of Supreme Court (Art 143)
Procedure for Amendment of Constitution (Art 368), Election of Members of Rajya Sabha

articles_and_parts.subject: The Union and its Territory
articles_and_parts.high_yield_article: Art 1 (India, that is Bharat, shall be a Union of States), Art 3 (Formation of new States and alteration of areas, boundaries or names of existing States by Parliament)

articles_and_parts.subject: Citizenship
articles_and_parts.high_yield_article: Art 11 (Parliament to regulate the right of citizenship by law - Citizenship Act 1955)

articles_and_parts.subject: Fundamental Rights (Magna Carta of India)
articles_and_parts.high_yield_article: Art 14 (Equality before Law), Art 17 (Abolition of Untouchability), Art 19 (Six Freedoms), Art 21 (Right to Life & Personal Liberty), Art 21A (Right to Elementary Education - 86th CAA 2002), Art 32 (Right to Constitutional Remedies - 'Heart and Soul of the Constitution' as per Dr. Ambedkar; 5 Writs: Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Certiorari, Quo-Warranto)

articles_and_parts.subject: Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)
articles_and_parts.high_yield_article: Art 39A (Equal Justice & Free Legal Aid), Art 40 (Organisation of Village Panchayats), Art 44 (Uniform Civil Code - UCC), Art 45 (Early childhood care & education), Art 48A (Protection of environment, forests and wildlife), Art 50 (Separation of Judiciary from Executive), Art 51 (Promotion of international peace and security)

articles_and_parts.subject: Fundamental Duties
articles_and_parts.high_yield_article: Added by 42nd CAA 1976 on recommendation of Swaran Singh Committee (initially 10 duties; 11th duty added by 86th CAA 2002 for parent/guardian to provide education to child aged 6-14)

articles_and_parts.subject: The Union Government
articles_and_parts.high_yield_article: Art 52 (President of India), Art 61 (Procedure for Impeachment of President), Art 72 (Pardoning Power of President), Art 76 (Attorney General for India), Art 108 (Joint Sitting of Parliament summoned by President, presided by Lok Sabha Speaker), Art 110 (Money Bill - certified by Speaker), Art 112 (Annual Financial Statement / Union Budget), Art 123 (Ordinance Making Power of President), Art 124 (Supreme Court), Art 143 (Advisory Jurisdiction of SC), Art 148 (Comptroller and Auditor General of India - CAG)

articles_and_parts.subject: The State Governments
articles_and_parts.high_yield_article: Art 153 (Governors of States), Art 161 (Pardoning Power of Governor), Art 165 (Advocate General for the State), Art 213 (Ordinance Making Power of Governor), Art 214 (High Courts for States), Art 226 (Power of High Courts to issue Writs - broader scope than Art 32)

articles_and_parts.subject: Panchayats and Municipalities
articles_and_parts.high_yield_article: 73rd CAA 1992 (11th Schedule, 29 subjects for Panchayats) and 74th CAA 1992 (12th Schedule, 18 subjects for Municipalities)

articles_and_parts.subject: Finance, Property, Contracts and Suits
articles_and_parts.high_yield_article: Art 266 (Consolidated Fund & Public Account of India), Art 267 (Contingency Fund of India held by Secretary, Dept of Economic Affairs on behalf of President), Art 279A (Goods and Services Tax Council - 101st CAA 2016), Art 280 (Finance Commission appointed by President every 5 years), Art 300A (Right to Property - legal right after 44th CAA 1978 deleted it from Fundamental Rights Art 31)

articles_and_parts.subject: Services under Union & States
articles_and_parts.high_yield_article: Art 312 (All-India Services created by Rajya Sabha resolution), Art 315 (Union and State Public Service Commissions)

articles_and_parts.subject: Elections
articles_and_parts.high_yield_article: Art 324 (Superintendence, direction and control of elections vested in Election Commission of India), Art 326 (Elections on basis of Adult Suffrage - voting age 18 years via 61st CAA 1988)

articles_and_parts.subject: Emergency Provisions
articles_and_parts.high_yield_article: Art 352 (National Emergency on grounds of War, External Aggression, or Armed Rebellion), Art 356 (President's Rule / State Emergency due to failure of constitutional machinery), Art 360 (Financial Emergency - never declared in India till date)

articles_and_parts.subject: Amendment of the Constitution
articles_and_parts.high_yield_article: Power of Parliament to amend the Constitution and procedure therefor (By Simple Majority, Special Majority, or Special Majority with ratification by at least half of State Legislatures)

twelve_schedules.provisions: Names of the States and Union Territories and their territorial extent (28 States and 8 UTs)
Salaries, allowances, and emoluments of President, Governors, Speaker/Deputy Speaker, Judges of SC/HC, and CAG
Forms of Oaths and Affirmations for Union Ministers, MPs, Judges, and CAG
Allocation of seats in the Rajya Sabha (Council of States) to States and UTs (UP has maximum 31 seats)
Administration and control of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes
Administration of Tribal Areas in 4 North-Eastern States: Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram (Mnemonic: AMTM)
Division of powers between Union and States in 3 Lists: Union List (100 subjects), State List (61 subjects), Concurrent List (52 subjects)
22 Recognized Official Languages of India (Original: 14; Added: Sindhi by 21st CAA 1967; Konkani, Manipuri, Nepali by 71st CAA 1992; Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, Santhali by 92nd CAA 2003)
Validation of certain Acts and Regulations beyond judicial review (added by 1st CAA 1951; subject to basic structure review post-1973 per I.R. Coelho case)
Anti-Defection Law (Disqualification of MPs/MLAs on ground of defection; added by 52nd CAA 1985; amended by 91st CAA 2003)
Panchayati Raj functional subjects (29 subjects; added by 73rd CAA 1992)
Municipalities functional subjects (18 subjects; added by 74th CAA 1992)

constitutional_bodies.composition: 1 Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) and 2 Election Commissioners appointed by President for 6 years or up to 65 years of age
constitutional_bodies.role: Conducts elections for President, Vice-President, Parliament, and State Legislatures

constitutional_bodies.body: Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG)
constitutional_bodies.composition: Appointed by President for 6 years or up to 65 years of age. Known as 'Guardian of the Public Purse' and 'Friend, Philosopher and Guide' of Public Accounts Committee (PAC)
constitutional_bodies.role: Audits accounts of Union, States, and public sector undertakings

constitutional_bodies.composition: Chairman and 4 other members appointed by President every 5 years (16th Finance Commission headed by Dr. Arvind Panagariya)
constitutional_bodies.role: Recommends devolution of net proceeds of taxes between Union and States

constitutional_bodies.composition: Appointed by President; holds office during pleasure of President. Highest Law Officer of the country
constitutional_bodies.role: Right of audience in all courts in India; right to speak in both Houses of Parliament but without right to vote (Art 88)

constitutional_bodies.composition: Chairman and members appointed by President for 6 years or up to 65 years of age
constitutional_bodies.role: Conducts examinations for recruitment to All-India and Central Civil Services

constitutional_bodies.body: Goods and Services Tax Council (GST Council)
constitutional_bodies.composition: Chaired by Union Finance Minister; Members: Union Minister of State in charge of Revenue/Finance and State Finance Ministers
constitutional_bodies.role: Makes recommendations on GST tax slabs, exemptions, model laws, and threshold limits
